$comment: Production npm audit advisories accepted temporarily. Every entry needs a reason it is not exploitable here and an expiry date; scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI once it expires so the decision is revisited.

allow.reason: ReDoS needs an attacker-controlled extglob pattern. jev-codeguard never globs with ts-morph: the Project is created with skipAddingFilesFromTsConfig and files are added only via createSourceFile(path, content) (src/core/hybrid-ast-engine.ts). No patched picomatch exists yet (all versions <= 4.0.7 affected), and the ts-morph@26 downgrade suggested by npm still pulls picomatch@2 through fast-glob.
